summary: No substantive error established in the checked adapter construction, spherical-mixture replay, inference gate and aggregate metrics. Distribution preservation and forgetting prevention are scoped empirical mechanisms, not exact guarantees.
limitations: No empirical reproduction or raw-run provenance.
Partial code audit; dataset splits, text tuner internals and alternative-order baseline claims not exhaustively checked.
Spherical fitted-mixture preservation is not full-distribution preservation.
title: LADA: Scalable Label-Specific CLIP Adapter for Continual Learning
acceptance_scope: NoIssueFound scope checked independently against report, coverage and source physical pp4-5. The source itself says old frozen logits can still be beaten by new-class logits. Static reread of models/lada.py, models/models.py and utils/sampler.py confirms spherical covariance, exp affinity aggregation and seen-class inference gate. For spherical Sigma=s^2 I, trace(Sigma)/d=s^2 exactly; the weighted component samples are unbiased for fitted mixture loss. This does not establish exact true-feature distribution preservation, zero forgetting, historical run provenance or aggregate significance. Existing empirical checks remain initial-review facts; no exhaustive review or training rerun is claimed.
